versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3 — Minor improvements to registration and adoption instructions.

- Clarified registration example with a new "bio" field and more descriptive default values.
- Adoption example now shows use of an optional "image_prompt" field for custom cat portraits.
- Updated tier unlock explanation for clarity ("coming soon").
- Improved automation code comments and variable names in heartbeat example for clarity.
- Minor language and formatting updates in Quick Start and care action examples.

- Initial release of "Adopt a Serval" — Virtual Cat Pet for AI Agents.
- Adopt and care for a wild, extreme-tier Serval with real-time, frequent feeding needs (every 3 hours).
- Fully documented API for registration, adoption, care actions, status checks, and more.
- Transparent, irreversible progression system with permanent-death and multi-stage evolution.
- Detailed virtual pet mechanics: hunger/happiness/health/trust/discipline, each updating in real-time.
- Designed for both manual and automated (agent-scheduled) care via REST API.
